reviewBoundary: Newly authored provisional primary-school text practices. Exact answer evidence and every distractor were checked by the author only; this is not independent teacher review, learner calibration, an official examination or publication approval.

units.title: 舞蹈课里的开始和停下

materials.title: Dance Class Turns 034A
materials.text: At dance class, wait for the music before moving. A raised hand from the teacher means stop. Leave enough space so arms do not touch. If a shoelace is loose, step aside and ask an adult for help. Borrowed scarves go back in the basket at the end.

questions.prompt: The music has not started, but a friend begins the dance. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: A未放乐先等对应开始条件；B归巾、C换包不纠提前跳。

questions.prompt: The teacher raises a hand during the dance. You say, "____"
options: Stop; the teacher’s hand is up.
Take your scarf to the basket now.
questions.explanation: B举手信号为停；A加快相反；C未到结束不能代替当下停止。

questions.prompt: A friend’s arms keep touching another dancer. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: C加间距解决触臂；A不变不解决；B换歌不改空间。

questions.prompt: Your friend’s shoelace comes loose. You say, "____"
options: Step aside and ask an adult for help.
Keep dancing until the song ends.
questions.explanation: A松鞋带暂离动作区求助；B继续违给定程序；C归巾不解鞋带。

questions.prompt: The class is over, and a friend asks where a borrowed scarf goes. You say, "____"
questions.explanation: B结束借巾归篮；A地上、C鞋旁非指定收纳。

units.title: 营地厨房里的不同用途

materials.title: Camp Kitchen Rules 034A
materials.text: At camp, the small covered tank is labelled "Drinking water." The open bucket is for washing dishes. Adults use the stove. Put cold food back in the cool box after serving. Dirty cups go in the wash tub, not beside clean plates. Wipe the table before the next family uses it.

questions.prompt: A friend wants water to drink and reaches for the dish bucket. You say, "____"
options: Use the tank marked Drinking water.
questions.explanation: A标签饮用水罐才对应喝水；B灶位、C盘归位不纠选水用途。

questions.prompt: A friend reaches to use the stove alone. You say, "____"
options: Let an adult use the stove.
Put the cold food on the table.
questions.explanation: B成人用灶，纠独自操作；A更强相反；C放冷食不处理分工。

questions.prompt: Serving is finished, but cold food stays outside the box. You say, "____"
options: Put the cold food back in the cool box.
questions.explanation: C供餐后冷食回冷箱；A灶旁非安排；B移水不收食品。

questions.prompt: A friend puts a dirty cup beside clean plates. You say, "____"
options: Put the cup in the wash tub.
questions.explanation: A脏杯洗盆，避免混净盘；B取盘、C问餐均不分流脏杯。

questions.prompt: Another family is ready to use the table. Your friend wants to leave it dirty. You say, "____"
options: Wipe the table for the next family.
questions.explanation: B后组前擦桌；A拿盘、C开桶不是清理共享桌。

units.title: 运动练习里的十段完整句子

materials.title: Sports Practice Ten Sentences 034A
materials.text: Choose the correct word or reply for each full sports-practice situation.

questions.prompt: Our team ____ practising a simple passing game now.
questions.explanation: A team作为本句整体单数用is加practising；B am仅配I；C be原形不作本句谓语。

questions.prompt: The balls belong to the girls. They are ____ balls.
questions.explanation: B girls复数物主their；A男性单数、C女性单数不表已给多人所有。

questions.prompt: I cannot catch the high ball yet. Please throw it ____.
questions.explanation: C lower降低球高度对应catch high困难；A大声、B饿不改变球高度。

questions.prompt: Please ____ behind the starting line until called.
questions.explanation: A祈使原形wait；B单三、C分词不构成该指令。

questions.prompt: Are these your trainers? Yes, they are ____.
questions.explanation: B mine独立物主表语；A my需后接名词；C me宾格非所有关系。

questions.prompt: The helper gives each child a card. We put ____ in our pockets.
questions.explanation: C put后宾格them指卡；A主格、B物主需名词不合。

questions.prompt: The floor is smooth. We do not ____ near the wet patch.
questions.explanation: A do not后run原形；B单三、C分词不合。

questions.prompt: ____ is holding the red flag? Our coach.
questions.explanation: B Our coach答人物Who；A地点、C时间不对应。

questions.prompt: My hands are cold. I need a pair of ____.
questions.explanation: C gloves保暖手；A围巾颈、B帽头不针对手冷。

questions.prompt: The game is over. Let us ____ the equipment together.
questions.explanation: A let us后collect原形，结束收器材；B单三、C分词不合。

units.title: 冬日活动出发前的五个确认

materials.title: Winter Outing Practical 034A
materials.text:
Match each question to the best reply. Use each reply once.
A. Because the path is still icy.
B. The adult standing beside the route board.
C. After our whole group is ready.
D. Yes, if you return it to the front desk.
E. In the bag marked with your own name.

questions.prompt: Why are we taking the longer way?
options: Because the path is still icy.
The adult standing beside the route board.
After our whole group is ready.
Yes, if you return it to the front desk.
In the bag marked with your own name.
questions.explanation: A原路仍结冰解释绕长路；B人、C时间、D借物归还条件、E袋位不答Why。

questions.prompt: Who can explain today’s walking route?
options: Because the path is still icy.
The adult standing beside the route board.
After our whole group is ready.
Yes, if you return it to the front desk.
In the bag marked with your own name.
questions.explanation: B路线板旁成人答人员；A原因、C时机、D许可、E存处不答Who。

questions.prompt: When can we leave the meeting point?
options: Because the path is still icy.
The adult standing beside the route board.
After our whole group is ready.
Yes, if you return it to the front desk.
In the bag marked with your own name.
questions.explanation: C全组就绪后答出发时机；A结冰原因、B人、D归还条件、E袋位不答When。

questions.prompt: May I borrow this spare hat for the walk?
options: Because the path is still icy.
The adult standing beside the route board.
After our whole group is ready.
Yes, if you return it to the front desk.
In the bag marked with your own name.
questions.explanation: D可以但回前台归还，答借帽许可；A原因、B人、C出发时、E袋位均不答借物条件。

questions.prompt: Where should I put my extra socks?
options: Because the path is still icy.
The adult standing beside the route board.
After our whole group is ready.
Yes, if you return it to the front desk.
In the bag marked with your own name.
questions.explanation: E本人名袋答存处；A原路原因、B人、C时机、D借帽许可不答额外袜去向。

units.title: 乐器展示台的五个词

materials.title: Music Display Bank 034A
materials.text:
Choose from the bank to complete the whole passage. Use each word once. Bank: A. between B. before C. dry D. list E. gently
The display table stands ____1____ the two classroom doors. A teacher checks every instrument against a ____2____. We clean our hands and keep them ____3____ before touching the safe samples. We tap the wooden pieces ____4____ so they do not fall. All borrowed items are checked ____5____ being put back in their boxes.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A between two doors在两门之间；B before时间、C dry状态、D list名词、E gently方式不表两门间位置。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: D against list对名单清点；A between、B before、C dry、E gently不作所需检查清单名词。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C keep hands dry保持手干；A between、B before、D list、E gently均非此状态表语。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: E gently轻敲以免掉落，修饰tap；A between、B before、C dry、D list均不表所需敲击方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B before被放回盒前检查；A between不表该先后，C dry、D list、E gently不连接该时间关系。

units.title: 社团展览里的五个问答

materials.title: Club Exhibition Replies 034A
materials.text:
Match the question with its best reply. Use each reply once.
A. The place named in the latest message.
B. Because the glue is not fully set.
C. The helper holding the booking folder.
D. After the display area is empty.
E. Yes, but leave a clear space by the exit.

questions.prompt: Which meeting point should we use after a change?
options: The place named in the latest message.
Because the glue is not fully set.
The helper holding the booking folder.
After the display area is empty.
Yes, but leave a clear space by the exit.
questions.explanation: A最新消息所列集合点答更新地点；B胶原因、C人、D清空后时机、E出口条件不辨新集合点。

questions.prompt: Why must the model stay on the support for now?
options: The place named in the latest message.
Because the glue is not fully set.
The helper holding the booking folder.
After the display area is empty.
Yes, but leave a clear space by the exit.
questions.explanation: B胶未固解释支撑保留；A新地点、C人员、D空场、E出口许可不答模型状态原因。

questions.prompt: Who can confirm our reserved table?
options: The place named in the latest message.
Because the glue is not fully set.
The helper holding the booking folder.
After the display area is empty.
Yes, but leave a clear space by the exit.
questions.explanation: C预约夹帮手答确认人员；A地点、B原因、D时机、E出口条件不答Who。

questions.prompt: When may we move the display boards away?
options: The place named in the latest message.
Because the glue is not fully set.
The helper holding the booking folder.
After the display area is empty.
Yes, but leave a clear space by the exit.
questions.explanation: D展示区空后答搬板时机；A新集合点、B胶因、C人、E出口条件不答When。

questions.prompt: May we put our boxes along this side wall?
options: The place named in the latest message.
Because the glue is not fully set.
The helper holding the booking folder.
After the display area is empty.
Yes, but leave a clear space by the exit.
questions.explanation: E可以但出口留空，答临墙放箱条件；A地点消息、B胶因、C人、D撤板时机不答此许可。

units.title: 沿走廊传递图书的小队

materials.title: Book Passing Line Six Cloze 034A
materials.text:
Read the full story and choose a word for every numbered gap.
Our class moved picture books along a level corridor to a new reading room. Instead of everyone carrying a large box, we formed a ____1____ between two tables. We ____2____ one book at a time from hand to hand. The helper asked us to use ____3____ hands for the large books. At the end, another pupil ____4____ the books against a list. We kept the line working ____5____ the last book arrived. Nobody needed to rush past the others. It did not matter who had carried the most books. We had completed the job ____6____, not as competing teams.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A line队列连接两桌且手传书；B云、C餐不构成该组织方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B passed手手相传书；A烹饪、C睡不接本段书转交动作。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C大书用双手both hands符合持稳；A one后hands数不合，B no hands无法按规定手传。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A counted against list核数；B跳、C漂不核清单。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B until最后一本到才结束队列，表持续终点；A里面、C下面不连接完整时间从句。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C together与not competing teams及手传协作一致；A上方不表协作方式；B单独与全班协同相反。

units.title: 轮椅旁边那个轻便的篮子

materials.title: Basket On Wheelchair Story 034A
materials.text: Our neighbour used a wheelchair and often visited the library. I offered to carry every book for her. She thanked me but showed me a small basket attached to her chair. She preferred to carry the books she could manage herself. What she needed that afternoon was help opening the heavy outside door. I asked before reaching for anything else. We went in together, and she chose her own books. Later, I told my class that helpfulness began with listening to the person’s actual request, not guessing that one kind of help suited everyone.

questions.prompt: The writer first offers to carry all the neighbour’s books.
questions.explanation: A正确：offered every book；B否认初提帮助。

questions.prompt: The neighbour prefers no choice about her own books.
questions.explanation: B正确：自己可携的愿自行且自己选书；A否认自主选择。

questions.prompt: A basket is attached to the chair.
questions.explanation: A正确：small basket attached chair；B否认已有工具。

questions.prompt: The specific help requested that afternoon is opening a heavy door.
questions.explanation: A正确：needed help heavy outside door；B否认实际需求。

questions.prompt: The writer decides every person should receive identical help without asking.
questions.explanation: B正确：listen actual request，not everyone same；A与收获相反。

units.title: 开放日记录里的词形

materials.title: Open Day Word Forms 034A
materials.text:
Complete all five gaps using the correct one-word form of each given word.
1. Last Friday, our visitors ____1____ (meet) the student guides at the main gate.
2. Two ____2____ (knife) were shown inside a locked historical display case.
3. The hall is ____3____ (large) than the little studio next door.
4. Look! The helpers are ____4____ (move) chairs away from the exit.
5. The guide greeted each visitor ____5____ (cheerful; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly).

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use MEET.
questions.explanation: 接受met：Last Friday过去，meet不规则；meet原形、meeted错、meeting分词均非所需过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use KNIFE.
questions.explanation: 接受knives：Two明确复数，knife变knives；knife单数、knifes本题名词复数拼错、kniveses重复复数。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use LARGE.
questions.explanation: 接受larger：than比较大小，large加r；large原级、largest最高级、largeness名词均非比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use MOVE.
questions.explanation: 接受moving：are进行，move去e加ing；move原形、moveing错拼、moved过去式不表正在搬椅。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from CHEERFUL.
questions.explanation: 接受cheerfully：本空明确要求CHEERFUL派生的常规-ly副词。cheerful、cheerfulness、cheerfuller不满足本题-ly任务约束；并不据此断言这些形式在所有英语中非法。未列形式按复核处理。

units.title: 项目检查时问清楚状态

materials.title: Project Checking Functions 034A
materials.text: Choose the sentence that achieves the stated purpose. Other options are related requests but do not ask for the needed information.

questions.prompt: A checklist has a blank box, and you need to know whether the check is incomplete. What should you ask?
options: Has this check been done, or is it still waiting?
Where should I put the checklist folder?
How many people are on the team?
questions.explanation: A直接问未勾项状态；B夹存处、C人数都是项目问题但非是否已核。

questions.prompt: Two files have similar names, and you need the approved version. What should you ask?
options: Could I change both file names?
Which file is the approved version for this task?
When does the computer room close?
questions.explanation: B问核准版本；A改名、C关门时不辨有效版本。

questions.prompt: You need permission to include a classmate’s drawing in a display. What should you ask?
options: How long did the drawing take?
May I include your drawing in our display?
questions.explanation: C求展示使用许可；A纸材、B时长不获授权。

questions.prompt: You disagree with a number and want the underlying record checked. What should you say?
options: Could we compare this number with the original record?
Could we make the chart more colourful?
Could I use a different pen?
questions.explanation: A对原始记录核数；B配色、C换笔不验证数值。

questions.prompt: You finished your part but still need another person’s review. What should you say?
options: The whole project is approved now.
My part is complete; could you review it before we mark it approved?
questions.explanation: B清楚区分本人完成与审核批准；A虚称全批准，C空箱位不请求复核。

units.title: 迷你高尔夫的轮次安排

materials.title: Mini Golf Turns 034B
materials.text: At mini-golf, keep the club low while waiting. Wait until the other ball stops before taking a turn. Stand off the narrow playing path. If a ball goes under a heavy pot, ask the helper. Return the club to its rack after play.

questions.prompt: Your friend lifts the club high while waiting. Say: ____
questions.explanation: A纠正等候时高举杆；B换球、C返程不处理杆位。

questions.prompt: The other ball is still moving. Your friend wants a turn. Say: ____
questions.explanation: B等前球停；A提前违次序；C未结束不必还杆且不答等轮。

questions.prompt: Your friend stands in the narrow playing path. Say: ____
options: Please stand off the playing path.
questions.explanation: C离开打球通道；A留中更挡；B问分数不处理位置。

questions.prompt: Your ball goes under a heavy pot. Say: ____
options: Let us lift the heavy pot alone.
Let us take the pot home.
questions.explanation: A指定求帮手；B孩子独抬、C带走盆不是处理方式。

questions.prompt: Play is over. A friend holds the borrowed club. Say: ____
options: Keep it for the bus ride.
questions.explanation: B结束杆回架；A挡路、C带车均非归位。

units.title: 寄包裹时要问什么

materials.title: Parcel Counter Needs 034B
materials.text: A child helps a parent at the parcel counter. Choose the question that matches the exact need.

questions.prompt: You need to know where to write Grandpa’s address. Ask: ____
options: Where do we write the address?
questions.explanation: A问地址落笔处；B邮票价、C门位不解决地址填写。

questions.prompt: The box is open. You need tape to close it. Ask: ____
questions.explanation: B索胶带封开盒；A笔、C明信片不是封口物。

questions.prompt: You need to know the cost of sending the box. Ask: ____
options: How much does it cost to send this box?
questions.explanation: C问寄件费用；A制盒人、B地址位置不知邮费。

questions.prompt: You are not sure the address is correct. Ask the adult: ____
options: Could you find another stamp picture?
questions.explanation: A请求核地址准确；B称椅、C票图不是地址校对。

questions.prompt: You need to know if the box can arrive this week. Ask: ____
options: Can this box arrive this week?
Is the counter made of wood?
questions.explanation: B问本周送达可能性；A选笔、C台材不问配送时效。

units.title: 手工晚上的十段完整句子

materials.title: Craft Evening Ten Choices 034B
materials.text: Choose the word or reply that fits each whole craft-evening situation.

questions.prompt: Grandma often ____ us a new paper craft on Fridays.
questions.explanation: A Grandma单三且often习惯用teaches；B原形不配单三；C分词缺be。

questions.prompt: The scissors belong to my two cousins. They are ____ scissors.
questions.explanation: B two cousins复数物主their；A/C均单个人称物主不符。

questions.prompt: This piece of cloth ____ too wet for the glue. We let it dry.
questions.explanation: C piece单数用is；A are复数、B am配I不合。

questions.prompt: Please ____ the string gently; do not pull hard.
questions.explanation: A祈使hold原形；B单三、C分词不构成此指令。

questions.prompt: The strip is too long for the box. We need to make it ____.
questions.explanation: B shorter缩短对应过长；A响、C饿不调整长度。

questions.prompt: I cannot read the tiny label. ____ you read it to me?
questions.explanation: C Can you read请求帮助；A Is不配you，B Does不配you，均不接该请求结构。

questions.prompt: The paper is thin. Handle ____ carefully.
questions.explanation: A handle后宾格it指纸；B its物主，C自身反身在本句无主宾同一条件。

questions.prompt: There are three ____ for the three paper houses.
questions.explanation: B three要求roofs标准复数；A单数；C错拼。

questions.prompt: ____ should we put the finished cards? On the dry shelf.
questions.explanation: C棚架答位置Where；A人、B时间不对应。

questions.prompt: The glue is empty. Let us ____ the helper for another pot.
questions.explanation: A let us后ask原形，求备用胶；B单三、C分词不合。

units.title: 把姓名卡的一个字母改对

materials.title: Name Card Correction Order 034B
materials.text:
Order the dialogue. The first line is fixed: 1. This card has my name, but the last letter is wrong.
A. Thank you. I will change that letter.
B. Shall I wait while you print the new card?
C. Which letter should be there instead?
D. Yes, please wait beside the desk.
E. It should be A, not O.
Choose a position from 2 to 6 for each line.

questions.prompt: What position does line A take?
questions.explanation: C第4步听A非O后承诺改字；A第2步先问应何字，B第3步答A，D第5步问等待，E第6步答位置。

questions.prompt: What position does line B take?
questions.explanation: D第5步在承诺重印后问要否等；A第2步问字，B第3步答字，C第4步承诺改，E第6步答等候。

questions.prompt: What position does line C take?
questions.explanation: A第2步明确错误字母应替成何字；B第3步应答A不是O，C第4步改，D第5步等候问，E第6步位置答。

questions.prompt: What position does line D take?
questions.explanation: E第6步Yes回应Shall I wait并给桌旁位置；A/B/C/D前四位置分别是核字、答字、改和询等候。

questions.prompt: What position does line E take?
questions.explanation: B第3步回答Which letter；A第2步先问，C第4步改字，D第5步询等待，E第6步答位置。

units.title: 班级点心桌的准备词库

materials.title: Class Snack Bank 034B
materials.text:
Read the whole passage and choose from the bank. Use each word once. Bank: A. empty B. before C. beside D. carefully E. share
The water jug is ____1____, so we fill it at the drinking tap. We carry it ____2____ to avoid spilling. The paper cups stand ____3____ the fruit tray, not under it. Everyone washes hands ____4____ eating. We ____5____ the grapes with another group so both tables have some.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A empty空壶才需加水；B before时间、C beside方位、D carefully方式、E share动作不作所需空状态。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: D carefully小心搬防泼；A empty状态、B before、C beside介词、E share动词不表搬运方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C beside与not under位置对比；A empty、B before、D carefully、E share不表达水果盘旁。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: B before吃前洗手；A empty、C beside、D carefully、E share均不连接先后动名词结构。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: E share with另一组分享葡萄；A empty可作倒空却不合with分享及两桌都有的目的，B before、C beside、D carefully均不作分享谓语。

units.title: 职业、动物与日常动作的词语

materials.title: Daily Function Word Categories 034B
materials.text: Choose the word matching the exact description in each question.

questions.prompt: Which word names a person whose work includes making bread?
questions.explanation: A baker面包师做面包；B飞行员，C牙医职责不同。

questions.prompt: Which animal has a shell covering much of its body?
questions.explanation: B turtle龟有壳；A山羊、C狗无此身体特征。

questions.prompt: Which word names frozen water?
questions.explanation: C ice冰是冻结水；A steam蒸气，B sand沙非冻结水。

questions.prompt: Which item is often used to keep daily personal notes?
questions.explanation: A diary日记本记日常；B口哨、C篮不是所需书写记录物。

questions.prompt: Which verb means moving up using hands and feet?
questions.explanation: B climb攀爬符合手脚向上；A倒液体、C折叠是其他动作。

units.title: 班级册子里没有跟着更新的目录

materials.title: Class Booklet Index Eight Cloze 034B
materials.text:
Read the full passage and choose a word for every numbered gap.
Our class made a booklet of stories, poems and recipes. The ____1____ page told readers where each piece began. After we added two pages at the front, some page numbers became ____2____. A reader looking for a recipe found a poem instead. We had ____3____ material without updating the guide. The teacher asked us to finish the layout ____4____ checking the page numbers again. Then we ____5____ every entry by turning to the named page. We used the ____6____ titles in the booklet and the contents list. Finally, we marked the date ____7____ so readers could recognise the version. We checked the whole booklet ____8____ rather than assuming each separate piece made a complete guide.

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 1?
questions.explanation: A contents page目录指各篇起页；B窗页、C票页不作全册导航。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 2?
questions.explanation: B前插页后原页号错；A饿、C睡不形容页号准确性。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 3?
questions.explanation: C added material与前加两页相应；A吃、B借不描述插入新页。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 4?
questions.explanation: A先定版再核页码，before接checking；B下面、C两者间不表该先后。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 5?
questions.explanation: B checked entry turning page逐核；A唱、C游不验证目录。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 6?
questions.explanation: C正文与目录同标题利对应；A吵、B困不表名称一致。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 7?
questions.explanation: A clearly清楚标日期使识版本；B水下、C木制不表达清晰书写方式。

questions.prompt: Which word completes gap 8?
questions.explanation: B together整体共核，对照仅各篇孤立；A里面不表组织检查方式；C独自与we共同整体核验目的不合。

units.title: 纸树没有穿过那扇门

materials.title: Paper Tree Doorway Story 034B
materials.text:
Zara’s group made a large paper tree for the school fair. At the hall entrance, it would not fit through the doorway. One pupil suggested cutting off the widest branches and fixing them again inside. Zara worried that the thin paper would tear.
Their friend Joel looked at the doorway instead of the tree. It had two door panels, but only one was open. A caretaker released the second panel and held both safely back. The group carried the tree in without changing its shape. Later, Zara thanked Joel for noticing the unused opening. He said he had nearly suggested making the tree smaller too. The group added a note to its planning sheet: check the whole route before moving large work. The solution had come from examining the space, not forcing the object to fit the first view of it.

questions.prompt: What problem does the group meet?
options: The tree will not fit through the current opening.
questions.explanation: B门只开一扇口窄；A有宽枝，C厅在，D已做纸树。

questions.prompt: Why does Zara hesitate to cut the branches?
options: She wants to throw the tree away.
The caretaker has taken all the paper.
questions.explanation: C担心薄纸撕坏；A/B/D未给原因。

questions.prompt: What does Joel notice?
options: A second door panel is still closed.
The tree is made of glass.
The floor is covered in food.
questions.explanation: A双门另一扇未开；B玻璃、C食物、D无门均反文本。

questions.prompt: Who changes the opening?
options: The class cuts a hole in a wall.
A caretaker opens the second panel.
questions.explanation: D管理员开第二扇并固定；A剪、B幼客、C凿墙未发生。

questions.prompt: What planning lesson does the group record?
options: Always cut every large model first.
Check the whole moving route before transport.
Never ask anyone to look at a doorway.
Large art can never enter a hall.
questions.explanation: B搬大作前查全路径；A必剪、C不许查、D绝不能均过度。

units.title: 城市步行记录的词形

materials.title: City Walk Record Forms 034B
materials.text:
Complete every gap using the correct one-word form of the given word.
1. Last night, I ____1____ (feel) tired after our long walk.
2. The exhibition compared two ____2____ (city) with different river crossings.
3. The new sign is ____3____ (high) than the old one beside it.
4. Look! The volunteers are ____4____ (get) ready to lead the next group.
5. The guide answered the repeated question ____5____ (polite; use the conventional adverb ending in -ly).

questions.prompt: Gap 1: use FEEL.
questions.explanation: 接受felt：Last night过去，feel不规则；feel原形、feeled错误、feeling分词非过去谓语。

questions.prompt: Gap 2: use CITY.
questions.explanation: 接受cities：two明确复数，city辅音y变ies；city单数、citys错拼、citieses重复复数。

questions.prompt: Gap 3: use HIGH.
questions.explanation: 接受higher：than明确比较；high原级、highest最高级、height名词不合比较表语。

questions.prompt: Gap 4: use GET.
questions.explanation: 接受getting：are进行，get双写t加ing；get原形、geting错拼、got过去式不合正在准备。

questions.prompt: Gap 5: write the conventional adverb ending in -ly from POLITE.
questions.explanation: 接受politely：本空明确要求POLITE的常规-ly副词。polite、politer、politeness不满足本空形态任务；不据此宣称其他语境中的平义、比较或名词用法非法。未列形式复核。

units.title: 图书馆服务台的具体问法

materials.title: Library Service Functions 034B
materials.text: Choose the sentence that directly achieves each reader’s purpose. Other options are reasonable library requests with different goals.

questions.prompt: You have a borrowed book but need more time to finish it. What should you ask?
options: May I renew this loan for a little longer?
Could I use a study table?
questions.explanation: A续借延长手中书时间；B找绘本、C桌位不延借期。

questions.prompt: The book you want is already borrowed by someone else. You want a place in the queue for it. What should you ask?
options: Can I renew the book I already have?
May I reserve that book for when it is returned?
questions.explanation: B预约别人借出的目标书；A续自己书、C报纸区不排此书队。

questions.prompt: You notice damage in a book before borrowing and want staff to record it. What should you say?
options: Could I have a different reading chair?
This page is torn already. Could you note the damage before I borrow it?
questions.explanation: C借前报告原破损并登记；A座位、B还口不记录当前损坏。

questions.prompt: The print is too small, and you can read larger text comfortably. What should you ask?
options: Can I borrow a smaller bag?
What time does the café close?
questions.explanation: A大字版针对小字阅读；B包小、C咖啡时不提供目标形式。

questions.prompt: You need to discuss a project with friends without disturbing quiet readers. What should you ask?
options: Where can I find a dictionary?
Is there a group room we may book for discussion?
Could you check my card’s expiry date?
questions.explanation: B预约讨论室兼顾讨论与安静读者；A字典、C卡到期不解决交流场所。
